description: agent-action under v43 exercising http:request(method=post,origin=https://api.example.com). A method value holds no lower-case letter (SPEC §7.2 rule 4), so the exercised scope is malformed: verifier MUST reject with E_BAD_SCOPE_GRAMMAR.

expected.rejection_reason: HTTP methods are case-sensitive and the registered ones are upper case (RFC 9110 §9.1). A server that treats post as POST runs the one method that method!=POST withholds, so a lower-case method is refused before §7.4 compares it.
